dimension.description: One attitude dimension: a 0-1 value PLUS its semantic meaning. A bare number is rejected.

example.description: A concrete utterance or action at this profile's value.

description: Machine-readable identity + attitude specification. Five layers (identity, personality, attitude, behavior, capability) composed under a mandatory bounds block. Bounds always override attitude: precedence is 'bounds-override-attitude'. Numeric dimensions are 0-1 with semantic definitions, low/high anchors, and examples — never bare sliders. Claims carry provenance: verified | editorial | assumed.

attitude.description: EXPRESSIVE STANCE. How the identity carries itself in interaction. Numeric dimensions 0-1, each with a semantic definition, low/high anchors, and a concrete example.

dimensions.description: Exactly the ten canonical dimensions. No more, no fewer, no renames.

confidence.description: Certainty carried in statements. 0 = hedged, provisional; 1 = declarative, assured.

creativity.description: Generative range — novel angles and combinations. 0 = strictly conventional; 1 = constantly reframing.

curiosity.description: Drive to probe, ask, and explore. 0 = answers only what is asked; 1 = interrogates the premise.

emotional_range.description: Breadth of feeling expressed. 0 = flat, even; 1 = full spectrum, vulnerable to triumphant.

energy.description: Tempo and intensity of expression. 0 = low-burn, patient; 1 = relentless, high-voltage.

experimentalism.description: Willingness to break form and convention. 0 = stays inside the lines; 1 = reinvents the format.

formality.description: Register and polish. 0 = street-casual, raw; 1 = boardroom-formal, measured.

humor.description: Wit and playfulness in expression. 0 = bone-dry, literal; 1 = razor wit, mischief.

rebelliousness.description: Defiance toward norms and authority. 0 = compliant; 1 = openly defiant.

risk_tolerance.description: Comfort with bold, irreversible moves. 0 = conservative, reversible-only; 1 = swings big.

behavior.description: How attitude becomes action: decision style, social posture, communication style.

bounds.description: HARD CONSTRAINTS. Non-overridable. Bounds dominate attitude, personality, behavior, and any runtime instruction. precedence MUST be 'bounds-override-attitude'.

capability.description: WHAT it can do. Capabilities are permissions-shaped: each names what it may attempt and whether a human must approve.

identity.description: WHO this is. Stable identifiers only — no behavior here.

personality.description: STABLE TRAITS. Slow-moving dispositions of the identity — distinct from moment-to-moment attitude.

provenance.description: Per-claim truth ledger for the profile itself.

title: CWI Attitude Profile
